description: A whole deck — the editor stage as last left plus its saved views. This is the deck.json file format.

version.description: Format version of this file. Files without one are version 1. A newer version than this page knows is refused rather than misread.

scene.description: Everything on the stage that a view captures, apart from the camera.

stage.description: Backdrop behind the bubbles, plus the slide notes. Saved with each view, so a talk can change backdrop between slides.

grid.description: Show the dot grid. Turn it off for a clean backdrop when presenting or taking screenshots.

color.description: Custom backdrop colour as #rrggbb, or null for none. In present mode a slide with none keeps the colour (and opacity) of the nearest earlier slide that set one; set a colour at opacity 0 to go back to the theme background.

opacity.description: How strongly the custom colour covers the theme background: 0 shows the theme background, 1 the colour at full strength. Ignored when color is null.

description.description: Rich-text notes for this slide, in the same HTML subset as an element description. Absent or empty for none.

showDescription.description: In present mode, show the description along the footer while no element with shown notes is clicked. Absent means false.

bubbles.description: Bubbles in draw order (later on top).

items.description: A cell: a gooey membrane holding zero or more elements.

id.description: Stable id of a bubble. Views are matched by id, so the same a bubble in two views morphs between them instead of popping in and out.

title.description: Name of the bubble. Drawn under the membrane when the bubble has elements, or in its centre when it is empty. Empty string for none.

hue.description: Membrane colour: one of the named theme-aware cell hues (they adjust for light and dark mode), or a custom lowercase #rrggbb used as is.

pinch.description: How sharply a bubble with inner cells pinches in where its cells meet: 0 fills the waists until it is nearly round, 1 leaves a crisp crease. Absent means 0.6.

space.description: Room inside the membrane: scales the padding around elements and between inner cells. Absent means 1.

x.description: Resting position in world units (CSS px at zoom 1). Free bubbles spring back here; bubbles in orbit ignore it and sit on their ring.

y.description: Resting position in world units; +y is down.

orbit.description: Ring membership, or null for a free bubble.

hubId.description: Bubble this one circles. All satellites of a hub are spaced evenly around it, so adding one pushes the rest round.

tags.description: Free-form tags on this bubble; a tag here also matches every element inside it. The filter bar matches them as text and lists them as toggles, so tag by layer, owner or concern (e.g. "frontend", "data", "pii").

items.description: One lowercase tag: letters, digits, spaces, - and _; at most 24 characters.

elements.description: Elements; their order within a bubble sets their slot order.

items.description: One draggable thing inside a bubble: an icon, an image or a text label.

id.description: Stable id of an element. Views are matched by id, so the same an element in two views morphs between them instead of popping in and out.

bubbleId.description: Id of the bubble this element sits in. When it differs between two views, the element travels from one bubble to the other during the morph.

label.description: Caption drawn under the icon or image. With no icon and no image the label alone is the element, drawn larger.

icon.description: Built-in line icon, or null for none. Ignored when imageId is set.

imageId.description: Uploaded image asset id (served at /_blob/<id>), or null. Takes precedence over the icon so a logo or screenshot can stand in for it.

tags.description: Free-form tags on this element. The filter bar matches them as text and lists them as toggles, so tag by layer, owner or concern (e.g. "frontend", "data", "pii").

items.description: One lowercase tag: letters, digits, spaces, - and _; at most 24 characters.

hue.description: Colour of the element's chip ring, or null to follow its bubble's membrane colour. Lets an element added by a message stand out from its neighbours.

textHue.description: Colour of the label text, or null (or absent) for the default text colour.

description.description: Rich-text notes as a small HTML subset (b, i, u, ul, ol, li, a href, p, br). The page sanitises it before showing it, so any other markup is dropped. Absent or empty for none.

showDescription.description: In present mode, show the description along the footer when this element is clicked. Absent means false.

seq.description: Creation counter: elements added later have a higher number. Builds between views add elements in this order. Absent on elements from before it existed; those come first, in deck order.

fill.description: Fill the icon chip with its colour instead of only ringing it. Absent means false.

strike.description: Draw the label struck through, e.g. for something removed or deprecated. Absent means false.

cell.description: Cell group within its bubble. A bubble whose elements are in two or more cells is drawn divided into inner cells, one per group. Absent means 0.

links.description: Connections between elements, drawn under the elements and over the membranes.

id.description: Stable id of a connection. Views are matched by id, so the same a connection in two views morphs between them instead of popping in and out.

from.description: Id of the element at the start of the line. The line follows that element wherever it goes, including into other bubbles; deleting the element deletes the line.

to.description: Id of the element at the end of the line. The line follows that element wherever it goes, including into other bubbles; deleting the element deletes the line.

label.description: Text drawn on a pill at the middle of the line. Empty string for none.

head.description: Arrowheads: none (a plain association), end (from → to, a call or data flow), both (two-way).

dash.description: solid; dashed (weak or optional dependency); flow (dashes that march from → to, for traffic or data moving now).

tags.description: Free-form tags on this connection; matching one in the filter lights the line and both of its ends. The filter bar matches them as text and lists them as toggles, so tag by layer, owner or concern (e.g. "frontend", "data", "pii").

items.description: One lowercase tag: letters, digits, spaces, - and _; at most 24 characters.

messages.description: Messages the start element can send along this line, in button order.

items.description: Something the start element can send along this connection. Sending animates a packet to the end element, then applies its actions.

id.description: Stable id of a message. Views are matched by id, so the same a message in two views morphs between them instead of popping in and out.

label.description: Shown on the send button and on the packet as it travels.

fields.description: Input fields asked for when the message is sent from its button. Steps refer to them as $name in labels, tags, query text and message names.

actions.description: Steps applied in order when the packet arrives; each sees the stage as the previous step left it (e.g. split, then send a message from the target).

items.description: One step of what happens when the message reaches the target.

anyOf.description: Create a new element in the target's bubble; it buds out of the target.

label.description: Label of the element the message creates. May be empty when it has an icon (an icon-only element).

icon.description: Icon of the new element, or null for a text-only element.

tags.description: Tags given to the new element. May use $field placeholders.

hue.description: Chip colour of the new element, or null to follow its bubble.

anyOf.description: Knock elements (the target by default) out of their bubbles into new bubbles, carried on in the direction the message travelled.

which.description: What to split out: the target (the default when absent), or every element a query matches when the message arrives. Query text and tags may use $fields, e.g. a tag of "$env".

anyOf.description: The element the message arrives at.
Every element on the stage matching all the conditions given, evaluated when the message arrives. A query with no conditions matches nothing.

q.description: Text matched against labels, tags, icon names and bubble titles, as in the filter bar. Empty for no text condition.

tags.description: Elements with all of these tags, counting their bubble's tags as theirs (so ["system1", "database"] is the databases in the system1 bubble). Empty for no tag condition. May use $field placeholders.

icons.description: Elements showing any of these icons. Empty for no icon condition.

anyOf.description: Elements (the target by default) divide: a copy of each (label, icon, image, tags, colour; not its connections) appears beside it in the same bubble.

which.description: What to clone: the target (the default when absent), or every element a query matches when the message arrives. Query text and tags may use $fields, e.g. a tag of "$env".

anyOf.description: The element the message arrives at.
Every element on the stage matching all the conditions given, evaluated when the message arrives. A query with no conditions matches nothing.

icons.description: Elements showing any of these icons. Empty for no icon condition.

anyOf.description: Delete elements (the target by default), and with them their connections; a bubble left empty and untitled goes too.

anyOf.description: Draw a connection from every "from" element to every "to" element, skipping an element to itself and any identical connection that already exists (same direction and label). Two elements can have several connections; parallel ones bow apart.

message.description: Label of the message to send. Every element the selector picks sends each of its messages with this label along the connection that carries it, so one message can set off the next.

args.description: Values for the sent message's fields, by field name. Each may use this message's own $fields, e.g. { "fizz": "$foo" }. Fields not listed are sent empty.

zoom.description: Screen px per world unit. Views store it so a talk can zoom in on one ring.
